description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointStore actor in Swift, responsible for managing the resolution and publishing of the gateway control endpoint within the application. It handles configurations, environment overrides, state management, and remote tunnel ensuring actions relevant to gateway connection endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor that manages the state and resolution of the gateway control endpoint, including handling configuration overrides, connection modes, remote tunnel ensuring, and observer subscriptions.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of GatewayEndpointState updates, buffered with the specified size.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current connection mode and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates the endpoint state accordingly.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures that the remote control tunnel is established and returns the port in use.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Requires a valid gateway configuration, refreshing the connection and returning the URL, token, and password.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing remote tunnel setup.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers the setup of the remote control tunnel if not already in progress.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures and retrieves the remote tunnel configuration, establishing the tunnel if necessary.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is remote, throws if not.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the direct remote gateway URL if configured for direct transport.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber given its UUID.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the internal state and notifies all subscribers with the new state.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fallback to a tailnet host when current URL points to localhost.

methods.name: resolveGatewayBindMode
methods.description: Resolves the gateway bind mode using environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCustomBindHost
methods.description: Resolves custom bind host from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayScheme
methods.description: Resolves the WebSocket scheme (ws/wss) based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveLocalGatewayHost
methods.description: Resolves the local gateway host depending on the bind mode, custom host, and tailscale IP.

methods.name: localConfig
methods.description: Constructs a local gateway configuration object based on current settings.

methods.name: dashboardURL
methods.description: Builds a URL for the gateway dashboard with appropriate schema, path, and query parameters.
